content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts exhibit significant upward bias during periods of high sentiment, failing to capture subsequent price drops.", "Forecasts display excessive mean reversion, smoothing out volatility and missing sharp downward trends in true outcomes.", "Sentiment history shows a lag in reacting to price declines, causing forecasts to remain elevated when prices fall.", "The model consistently overshoots peak prices, predicting continued growth while actual prices reverse direction.", "Forecast accuracy degrades rapidly after sentiment shifts from positive to neutral or negative.", "Price corrections are underestimated by the model, leading to persistent overestimation during bearish phases.", "Sentiment indicators should be weighted more heavily to adjust forecasts downward when sentiment drops below 0.5.", "The model fails to account for momentum shifts, resulting in delayed responses to sudden market reversals."]}
